integrity: The Ext formula is derived symbolically by splicing the published minimal two-step sequences and applying Hom to their explicit maps. No finite computation is used as evidence for the quantified theorem. Same-model review was performed; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only Enomoto's explicit two-dimensional family. It does not classify all modules or all Ext algebras over \(\Lambda(q)\), and it makes no new bimodule-periodicity claim for the algebra itself.
title: Complete Ext profile of Enomoto's two-dimensional syzygy family
